from pathlib import Path
p=Path('/home/ubuntu/continual-arc-baselines/.workbench/runs/adhoc-primeagentlearner-1790689854/attempts/71aa0823e1d7415ab0ea5a5c0e56a9c6/system/state/workspace/programs/task-f8002d88.py')
p.parent.mkdir(parents=True, exist_ok=True)
code='''def transform(grid):
    """Repeat the non-background pattern from one compartment into all compartments."""
    h, w = len(grid), len(grid[0])
    row_dividers = [r for r in range(h) if len(set(grid[r])) == 1]
    col_dividers = [c for c in range(w) if len({grid[r][c] for r in range(h)}) == 1]
    if not row_dividers or not col_dividers:
        return [row[:] for row in grid]
    divider_color = grid[row_dividers[0]][col_dividers[0]]
    # Restrict separators to the common divider color.
    row_dividers = [r for r in row_dividers if grid[r][0] == divider_color]
    col_dividers = [c for c in col_dividers if grid[0][c] == divider_color]
    def spans(n, separators):
        out, start = [], 0
        for x in separators:
            if start < x:
                out.append((start, x))
            start = x + 1
        if start < n:
            out.append((start, n))
        return out
    row_spans, col_spans = spans(h, row_dividers), spans(w, col_dividers)
    background = 7
    regions = [(r0, r1, c0, c1) for r0, r1 in row_spans for c0, c1 in col_spans]
    # The source is the compartment containing the most non-background cells.
    src = max(regions, key=lambda box: sum(grid[r][c] != background
                                           for r in range(box[0], box[1])
                                           for c in range(box[2], box[3])))
    sr0, sr1, sc0, sc1 = src
    pattern = [(r - sr0, c - sc0, grid[r][c])
               for r in range(sr0, sr1) for c in range(sc0, sc1)
               if grid[r][c] != background]
    out = [row[:] for row in grid]
    for r0, r1, c0, c1 in regions:
        for dr, dc, color in pattern:
            if r0 + dr < r1 and c0 + dc < c1:
                out[r0 + dr][c0 + dc] = color
    return out
'''

for r0 in (0,9,18):
 for c0 in (0,7):

test[4]=[9]*9
